title: i18n(plugin-approvals): ship the approval objects, notifications, record page and e-mail link line in ru, de and ko
body:

_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D7v5H7BaFmL7sUCoN7tSxhm)_

domain:server#1 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4cya5ej5GQV86RPbRPK

Part of #30512 — package 9 of 11, second half (`@objectstack/plugin-approvals` in `ru`, `de`, `ko`; the first half, `zh-Hant`, `ar`, `fr`, `pt-BR`, landed in #30790). With it the package serves all eleven platform languages. The card stays open: settings and platform-objects follow, and the last PR of the series makes the bundle check read the platform locale table.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 审批插件的 3 个对象（审批请求、审批动作、审批委派）的名称、字段、选项、帮助和动作，审批通知的 40 条句子，审批请求记录页的标题和「详情 / 时间线」两个标签，以及审批邮件里「打开审批」那一行，补上俄语、德语、韩语 3 种。繁中、阿语、法语、巴葡已在上半包（#30790）落地，至此本包 11 种语言齐全。
- **为什么改：** 平台语言表要求每个界面带齐 11 种语言；这是第 3 期按包补齐的第 9 个包的下半（每种语言 164 条对象文本 + 40 条消息）。用这 3 种语言的审批人和提交人看到的审批界面、通知和邮件不再是英文。
- **风险与回滚：** 只加翻译数据和注册行，不动逻辑、schema、接口；邮件模板的结构、选模板的规则和 `EMAIL_TEMPLATE_FLOOR_LOCALE` 都没动，只给「打开审批」那一行加了 3 种语言（按裁决 A）。原有 8 种语言一字未改。测试改动只是各语言测试把 3 种新语言加进列表（覆盖变宽，没有放宽任何断言）。回滚即撤 PR。
- **先看：** `src/translations/index.ts`（按表标签注册，zh-CN 在 zh-Hant 前，每种语言带页面标题和消息）、`src/approval-email-templates.ts` 的 `APPROVAL_EMAIL_LINK_LINES`、`src/translations/messages.ts`，再看 `sys-approval-request-page.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --filter=approvals` 输出 `plugins/plugin-approvals in sync`；`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-approvals test` 全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- Three new locales under the platform locale table's tags (`ru`, `de`, `ko`): each a `TAG.objects.generated.ts` with all 164 object leaves of `sys_approval_request`, `sys_approval_action` and `sys_approval_delegation`, plus its `TAG.source-hashes.generated.ts`, written by the repo's own `os i18n extract --fill=default --source-hashes` and served through `withSourceFallback` like the existing seven. `zh-CN` stays ahead of `zh-Hant` in `index.ts`.
- The hand-written records gain an entry per new locale: `messages.ts` (the 40 approval notification sentences; `approvalMessages` widens to all eleven), `pages.ts` (the record page label `sys_approval_request_detail`, recorded against the same `en` digest the existing seven carry), and the record page's inline Details / Timeline labels in `sys-approval-request.page.ts`.
- `approval-email-templates.ts`: `APPROVAL_EMAIL_LINK_LINES` (the line that opens the request from its e-mail, `{{approvalUrl}}` kept byte-identical) gains the three locales. This follows the seat's ruling A, as recorded in the handover commit `7db48bdd` and carried by #30790: the link line is added per locale; the e-mail templates' shape, the template selection and `EMAIL_TEMPLATE_FLOOR_LOCALE` are unchanged.
- The extract command in `scripts/i18n-extract.config.ts` lists the three tags and its merge baseline imports the three bundles with their page entries, so `check:i18n` covers them from this PR on.

## Tests

- `sys-approval-request-page.test.ts` pins the served locale set; it now lists the eleven locales this PR serves, and every served locale is still held to carrying the authored page label.
- `approval-status-vocabulary.test.ts`, `approve-decision-question.test.ts`, `decision-question-i18n.test.ts`, `success-copy-names-request-i18n.test.ts` and `admin-copy-vocabulary.test.ts` add the three new bundles to their locale lists. Coverage widens; no assertion changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Quality bar (#17508 / PR #19345):** every leaf written for the reader; placeholders, code spans and identifiers byte-identical, checked mechanically per leaf against `en` for the object bundles and for `messages.ts` (key set, `{{holes}}`, `{holes}`, backtick spans, angle tokens: all three locales OK, zero diffs).
- **Leaves equal to English, on purpose, each recorded by the extractor as a source copy:** `de` `Status`, the native word. In `messages.ts`, the reason separator `"; "` equals the English one in all three.
- No cross-locale coincidence: `check:i18n-stale-fill` passes with the baseline untouched.
- Carried unchanged from the released handover commit `2dffb78d` (session `session_01Utp6Cai5CRdAs4u9gTipWU`): the patch id of this PR's diff equals that commit's (`01aee2a9`). The serial row "after #30208 lands" was cleared by the seat (6672288503): #30208's rows that touch this package landed in PR #30551.
- The existing `ja-JP` / `es-ES` bundles still carry English source copies on `sys_approval_delegation`; this PR does not touch the existing locales.
- For the platform-objects PRs that follow: the account menu's `nav_account_approvals` label is pinned there to equal this package's `my_pending` label in each locale (the handover's cross-package pin); this PR fixes the `ru` / `de` / `ko` side of it.
